title: Left-side visibility and dangerous-feeling features
summary: Feedback in this topic centers on safety concerns, especially obstructed left-side visibility and several features that reviewers describe as dangerous or unsettling to use.

positive.summary: Positive feedback says visibility is good, with one example specifically praising left-corner visibility.

negative.summary: Negative feedback focuses on dangerous left-side blind spots, hard-to-confirm positioning, unsafe-feeling touchscreen and sensor behavior, jerky power delivery, and anxiety about technical features failing.

mixed.summary: Mixed feedback combines praise for left-corner visibility with stronger complaints that the left-side view is blocked and can make the corner dangerous.

limitations: This topic mixes related but not identical issues, including left-side visibility, touchscreen and sensor usability, jerky engine behavior, and general reliability worries.
Examples are limited, so the relative prominence of each specific issue within the topic cannot be determined from these fragments alone.
The sample is sentiment-stratified and not representative of all reviews for the model or market.
